title: Software Factory public data, version 1
description: Frozen in Phase 0 (docs/software-factory.md); the feature loops, tools and code were added on 2026-11-15 as optional fields and one more collection, so a version 1 reader still reads every snapshot. Every record a build or refresh publishes validates against one of these $defs, by name, with blog/software-factory/validate.mjs. A change to this file is a contract change: it goes through the merge loop, never one stream alone.

coverage.description: How much of the population a value is computed over. included <= total; missing counts the records left out because a needed value was absent.

table.description: Rows of numbers, one array per row, in the order of columns. Columns named like an axis (day, model, effort, status) hold an index into that axis of the overview.

pointer.description: latest.json: which snapshot is current, and when the source was last checked. Transport metadata: it changes on every check; a snapshot never does.

manifest.description: snapshots/<id>/manifest.json: what a snapshot was made from and what it holds. Deterministic: no clock in it but the source's own times.

inputCount.description: How many source files were read. Each is a record of the inputs collection (details/inputs.json), with its SHA-256. Since generator 13.

inputs.description: Until generator 13, the list itself (since then: inputCount, and the inputs collection). Every source file read, with its SHA-256. A path with a * stands for all the files read that match it (the examples' result files): its sha256 is of a line for each, '<path> <sha256>\n' in path order, and its bytes are their sum.

datasets.description: Measurement bounds and completeness per dataset. A period dataset covers [from, to) in UTC; a stock is a count at the source revision, with no period.

overview.description: overview.json: everything the first screen needs, compact. Period measures are recomputed in the browser from usage and verification for a chosen range; measures holds their all-time values, so the static page has them without script.

days.description: Every calendar day in the timezone from the first to the last day with activity, with no gaps.

usage.description: Model calls by day, model and effort; only the combinations that occur. Columns: day, model, effort, calls, pricedCalls, usd, inputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, outputTokens and, since generator 6, thinkingTokens (part of outputTokens) and uncachedUsd (the same priced calls as if nothing were cached: a hypothetical, never added to usd). Either is null for a row where a call has none.

verification.description: One row per completed job: day (of finishedAt in the timezone), status (index into ['passed', 'failed'], the process outcome only), wallSeconds (null when not a valid observation).

stocks.description: Counts at the source revision: not activity over a period.

verdict.description: Examples by verdict. The catalog's own verdict where it gives one. Where it gives none, the marks in the example's label: one kind of mark is that verdict, more than one kind is several, no mark is none. Since generator 8; before it, every example without a single verdict was none.

insights.description: Calculated observations: descriptive, reproducible from the data, with no causal claim and no model ranked above another.

loopAccount.description: The source's own account of its loops (llm-dlc/traces/loops.json), as it adds them up: moonshots, briefs and the verification loop, with runs from before the scripts left records. Apart from overview.loops, which is read from the run records and covers only the runs that left one. Null when the source has no such file. Since generator 7.

interjections.description: Prompts in any run that are not the loop's own, added over the runs.

byHand.description: The part of the totals that is the loop a person ran by hand, typing each instruction.

runs.description: Every run of the account, oldest first, with what a clock needs to draw it. A run from a run record has the id of its record in the loops collection. Since generator 9.

campaign.description: The brief a stream belongs to; for any other loop, the loop itself.

source.description: Where the source read the run from: record (a run record), transcript (a session's prompts) or session (a verification session).

hasRecord.description: Whether the loops collection has a record with this id: the run's own run record, or one read from the index of loops. Since generator 11.

ticks.description: Seconds from the run's start to the end of each cycle that committed.

reported.description: What Claude Code counted itself, summed over the sessions that had stopped and so had its count, beside the price of the calls in those sessions' logs. The logs leave some calls out, so the two differ. Another figure, never added to estimated usage. Null when no session has one. Since generator 6.

callsUsd.description: Estimated usage of the same sessions: the calls in their logs at list prices.

unattributedUsd.description: The part of the client's count that no call in a log explains, as the source adds it up session by session.

endurance.description: How the sessions lasted, from the source's rollup: time at work, compactions, the largest context, the sessions compacted at least once set against the rest, and what made a call write to the cache anew. The source's specification.md defines the times and the cache events. Null when the rollup says none of it. Since generator 10.

time.description: Seconds, added over every session. Model, tool and busy time are unions, since calls overlap: the time at least one was under way.

sessions.description: Sessions the rollup gives a count of compactions.

compacted.description: The sessions whose context was compacted at least once.

peakContext.description: The largest context a session reached, in tokens: the most over the sessions, and their median.

most.description: The session compacted most often. Null when none was.

cacheCauses.description: Cache events by the source's cause, in its order: a call that lost the cached prefix, or wrote 20,000 tokens or more with it intact. excessUsd is what the write cost above reading the same tokens from the cache; rereadUsd what later calls paid to read a large input again.

process.description: Whether the job ran as its steps expected; not whether a property holds.

signals.description: Semantic outcomes the job reported, such as example:as-expected or jvmcontract:fails, with their counts.

expected.description: The job's own statement of its expected outcome.

attention.description: Attention entries recorded at the time: history, not open blockers.

freshness.description: The example's snapshot field: current, unknown, or null when absent.

path.description: The example's folder in the source repository, examples/<id>-<slug>. Since generator 4.

summary.description: The catalog's one-paragraph summary of the example. Since generator 4.

sourceUrl.description: The published change the example verifies (a pull request or commit), https only.

testsPassed.description: The catalog's existingTestsPassed: whether the module's unit tests passed on the same patch.

severity.description: The catalog's severity if the change shipped unnoticed.

changeKind.description: The catalog's kind of change: refactor, feature, bug-fix, ...

evidence.description: What the verdict rests on, from the example's own result file. Text is as written, cut at 320 characters with an ellipsis. Null when the example has no result file. Since generator 5.

tests.description: The existing tests run on the same patch: the task, and up to five tests that failed.

counterexample.description: The first counterexample recorded: its input, what was expected and what came back, and how many were recorded.

trace.description: A model checker's trace: the invariant it breaks, its length, the action of each step (up to 24) and the states explored.

seconds.description: How long the attempt took, where the result records it.

checker.description: The checker the result names, such as JBMC 6.11.0.

loopsOverview.description: Feature loops: the recorded runs of feature-loop.sh, joined to their sessions' prompts by time (config/loops.json). Null when the source has no run record.

ledger.description: The run's cycles as its record lists them: when each committed, and the commit's summary line.

daily.description: Tool calls per day (index into days) made inside a recorded run, and outside one. Columns: day, inRuns, outside.

drive.description: Who set off each day's tool calls (config/loops.json, drivers), and how many prompts a person typed that day. Columns: day (index into days), loop, person, other, typed.

scripts.description: The commits that changed the loop's own scripts, oldest first. Null when the snapshot was not made from a git checkout.

toolsOverview.description: Tool calls and how they ended. errors = exit (the command ran and exited non-zero) + rejected (the harness refused the call: invalid input, or a pattern it blocks) + denied (a person or the permission classifier said no) + other. Null when no session has a tools table.

daily.description: Columns: day (index into days), model (index into models, or null), calls, errors, exit, rejected, denied, other.

byRunHour.description: Calls made inside a recorded run, by hours since that run started: from (inclusive) to (exclusive, null for the last).

byParallel.description: Calls made inside a recorded run, by the number of recorded runs under way when the call was made.

recovery.description: What followed each failed call in its session: the next call succeeded (nextOk), failed too (nextFailed), or there was none or it has no result recorded (noNext). streaks lists [failed calls in a row, how many times].

loopStat.description: One row of the source's account of its loops: the totals, a category or a loop. Times are seconds; usd is estimated usage at list prices.

catalogOverview.description: The example catalog's own answers about each example, counted by verdict as stocks.examples.verdict has it, and what its violations come with. Since generator 4.

tests.description: Examples whose entry says whether the existing tests passed on the same patch, by verdict.

severity.description: Examples by the severity the catalog gives the change, by verdict.

counterexamples.description: Of the examples whose verdict is a violation: those whose result records a counterexample's input, and those with a trace and no input. Since generator 5.

attempts.description: The examples whose result says how long the attempt took, and the middle one's seconds (null with none). Since generator 5.

codeOverview.description: Lines in the source repository's git history, classed by config/code.json. Null when the snapshot was not made from a git checkout.

repository.description: The lines of code in the repository as /prove-java-change/ counts them: lines added less lines removed, over the languages config/code.json names for it (the ids listed, largest first). Null when it names none. Since generator 12.

daily.description: Code lines per commit day (index into this record's days). Columns: day, added, removed, commits, surviving (of the day's added lines, those git blame still gives to its commits; null where nothing was blamed).

perChange.description: What each committed change took, where the rollup says: output tokens per line of code added, change by change. median, p10 and p90 are nearest-rank values over the changes that added code and were given output tokens. Null when no change has both a commit and a cost.

kind.description: The source's kind of loop, on a record read from its index of loops. Since generator 11.

source.description: On a record read from the source's index of loops, where the index read the run: a session's transcript, or a session of the verification loop. Absent on a record read from the run's own run record. Since generator 11.

reason.description: The index's word on how it read the run's end: typed by hand, no end recorded, summarized.

interjections.description: Prompts in the run that are not the loop's own, by the index.

change.description: The change the cycle committed, the first when it committed several; null for a cycle that ended without a commit.

commits.description: The commits the cycle made, on a record read from the index of loops.

recordUrl.description: The run's own run record; null for a run that left none.

inputs.description: details/inputs.json: every source file a snapshot was made from, in path order, each with the SHA-256 and size of the bytes read and the schema it declared ('' when it declares none). Since generator 13; until then the list was the manifest's source.inputs.

postSummary.description: A published post as the Software Factory pages show it, made by editorial.mjs from the already draft-filtered post collection.

author.description: From the post's own author field; null when the post does not say.

evidence.description: A post's evidence.json: the frozen data an analysis used. A complete manifest has every field non-null (editorial.mjs checks); a draft may be incomplete, never invented.

runtime.description: An observation from a producer on the factory machine (not built yet). Past expiresAt it is stale: shown as unavailable, never as zero active work.
